kashika: उः स्थानेऽण् प्रसज्यमान एव रपरो वेदितव्यः। कर्ता। हर्ता। किरति। गिरति। द्वैमातुरः। त्रैमातुरः। उरिति किम्? खेयम्। गेयम्। अण्ग्रहणं किम्? <<सुधातुरकङ् च>> [[४.१.९७]] — सौधातकिः॥
kashikaEnglish: When ऋ is replaced by अण् (अ, र्), the result is always followed by र् (rapara).
englishShort: Any अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ letter appearing as an आदेश in place of a ऋकार/ऌकार is always followed by the letter र्/ल् respectively.
englishFull:
When an अण् vowel (अ, इ, उ) substitutes for ऋ, it must be followed by र्.

By proximity, अ is the guṇa of ऋ (both are open vowels). But the actual substitute is अर्, not just अ.

**Examples:**
- कृ + ता = कर्ता "doer"
- हृ + ता = हर्ता "taker"

Similarly when ऋ → इ by @ref[7.1.100]: the substitute is इर्, not इ.
- पितृ + भ्याम् = पितृभ्याम् → पितिर्भ्याम् "by the two fathers"
